description:
We are a passionate and creative team of students working on innovative ideas to explore space, science, and technology. Our project, LUNA LIFE – THE LAST HOPE, is an interactive lunar survival application that helps learners understand the challenges astronauts may face while building and maintaining a habitat on the Moon.

Our team is interested in space exploration, coding, problem-solving, science, technology, and creativity. We enjoy learning new skills and sharing ideas.
